name: print-social-carousel-cream-navy-blue-brand-system-1
title: Cream/navy/blue nine-tile brand carousel, part one
whatItIs: A nine-tile Instagram carousel alternating cream, navy and near-black backgrounds, unified by one recurring blue accent color, bold sans headlines and small flat illustrative icons (hand, phone, globe).
whatItMeans: Rotating through only three backgrounds plus one accent color lets a nine-post carousel feel varied tile-to-tile while still reading as one unmistakable brand system.
techniques: restrict a whole carousel to three backgrounds plus a single accent color
vary content type per tile (stat, chat UI, question, illustration) while keeping the same type system
use a consistent small logo mark and 'Swipe' cue in the same corner across every tile

vocabulary.definition: a multi-slide social media post format where a viewer swipes through a sequence of images
